title: docs(skills,spec): name the dispatcher as the owner of the i18n routes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPE7uyDAJyqjwwMzomWv5ff)_

Fixes #37625

Clause-②: no (published prose and comments only; no behaviour changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：多语言技能文档里，「语言接口由翻译服务自己注册」这句话改成了「由运行时的 HTTP 分发器挂载，数据来自翻译服务」，同时在方法清单里补上 `getSourceLocale()` / `setSourceLocale()`。两处 spec 代码注释也做了同样的更正。代码和平台行为都不变。
- 为什么做：#37614 的审核发现这句话与 main 不符：翻译服务从 #23347 起就不再挂任何 HTTP 路由。自己手工组装内核的开发者照旧文档做，会以为装了翻译服务就有这三个接口，实际上没有。
- 出错会怎样：只改文字，撤回即可。为了不超出技能篇幅上限，同一文件里压缩了四处措辞，没有删掉事实。
- 要你做什么：这是受管的技能文件，需要审批人批准后才能合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, Registration.** Before: "It self-registers `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`, `/translations/:locale` and `/labels/:object/:locale`; …". After: "The runtime's HTTP dispatcher, which `os serve` composes, mounts `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`, `/translations/:locale` and `/labels/:object/:locale`, served from the i18n service; …". The rest of the sentence (the `isDefault` / `sourceLocale` clause) is unchanged. Checked on `main`: `packages/services/service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.ts:27-39` ("It mounts NO HTTP route", naming `createDispatcherPlugin` the one owner); `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts:1752`, `:1761`, `:1770` mount the three paths; `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` composes `createDispatcherPlugin`.
- **Same file, methods list (the card's optional item).** The `getLocales()` bullet gains `getSourceLocale()` / `setSourceLocale()`: both shipped implementations provide them (`file-i18n-adapter.ts:302`, `:307`; `core/src/fallbacks/memory-i18n.ts:275`, `:280`). `getFallbackLocale()` is left out: the file adapter has it (`:285`) but the in-memory fallback deliberately does not (its docblock at `:254`), and the list is "methods both shipped adapters implement".
- **Paid in the same file, no fact removed** (6306 → 6333 tokens, ceiling 6333): "is not in `node_modules` to read" → "is not in `node_modules`"; "Methods implemented by both shipped adapters" → "Methods both shipped adapters implement"; "full snapshot for a locale" → "a locale's full snapshot"; "You do not wire this plugin" → "Don't wire this plugin".
- **Spec comments.** The `GetLocalesResponseSchema` docblock (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) said the descriptor helper is shared by the dispatcher's `/i18n` domain "and `service-i18n`'s autonomous route"; it now names the dispatcher as the route's one owner (`service-i18n` mounts none since #23347). The `toLocaleDescriptors` comment (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) now says both once served the route and the dispatcher owns it. Comments only: no schema, describe or export changes.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/skills` and `@objectstack/spec` patch.

Small calls made here (no card): the skill names "the runtime's HTTP dispatcher, which `os serve` composes" rather than the internal `createDispatcherPlugin` name, which a client author cannot act on.

## Why

Review N1 of PR #37614 (contract record 7197064778): a shipped skill stated a wrong fact about where the i18n routes come from.

## Verification

Run at `a359107dd`, each exit 0:
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 6333/6333).
- `node scripts/check-skill-links.mjs`, `node scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs`, `node scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-docs`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: clean (#37422 and #37366 share `i18n-resolver.ts` and merge cleanly).

The skill edit was drafted by a contract-tier subagent, as `dispatch-gates --tier` requires for `skills/**`, and checked here against the cited lines; the spec comments were edited here.

Contract review (L2) is owed before landing: `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (comments only; none change).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
